name: mesh-shadergradient
title: Mesh Shader Gradient
description: A full-bleed animated gradient that keeps moving: broad orange and rust bands slide across deep shadow, with a faint grain and cool blue-grey glow creeping into the corners.
use: A landing page or hero needs a moving colour backdrop with no content of its own.
avoid: Content sits on top: the busy warm bands and grain can fight text, so it needs an overlay or muted settings.
a11y: A purely decorative canvas with no alt text or controls; it animates forever and ignores prefers-reduced-motion. (keyboard: n-a, labels: n-a, reduced motion: not handled)
looks: The whole frame is a grainy, full-bleed wash of warm colour. A broad diagonal band of orange and rust sweeps from upper left to lower right, a bright cream rim catching its edge, against deep near-black on the other side; blue-grey light gathers in the corners.
behaves: The gradient never stops moving: the bands slowly slide, bend and reform so the bright edge travels across the frame. No interaction is needed; it runs on its own as a looping animated surface.
customise: No props: colours, speed, strength, camera and grain are all fixed in the component file, so changing the palette means editing the ShaderGradient values.
weight: heavy: A full-screen WebGL shader recomputes the animated gradient on the GPU every frame.
issues: Bright orange bands leave little calm space, so overlaid text would need a scrim.
polishWhy: Smooth flowing colour and grain; it is a standard shader wash with little unique character.
